name: EroScripts
summary: The premier community forum where scripters share free funscript haptic motion tracks timed to scenes for The Handy, Keon, and OSR2.
ranking_rationale: Thousands of community-timed tactile .funscript tracks paired across studio & VR scenes; weighed against many scripts link out to scenes you still source/own separately.

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Thousands of community-timed tactile .funscript tracks paired across studio & VR scenes
Supportive script creators & open scripting tools like OpenFunscripter
cons: Many scripts link out to scenes you still source/own separately
Free registration needed to download most attachments
